_what_this_is: Public-domain / CC photographs from Wikimedia Commons, used to exercise the pipeline on images that are not PlantVillage. Only `crop` is asserted, and only where it is unambiguous from the photograph. There is no expert diagnosis behind any of these, so no disease label is claimed and nothing here should be quoted as an accuracy figure.
